text: The nightly ingest ETL freeze window at Halvard Systems runs from 02:15-02:45 UTC.
The Halvard Systems ingest warehouse cluster is named quartz-dw and runs on Snowflake.
The Halvard Systems ingest CI deploy token rotates every 45 days.
The Halvard Systems ingest gateway is served from eu-central-1.
Halvard Systems ingest on-call shifts last 7 days and hand over at 16:00 IST.
P1 pages for Halvard Systems ingest go to #halvard-p1-sev.
The Halvard Systems ingest batch job atlas-batch must never be restarted before 09:00 UTC.
Halvard Systems ingest feature flags live in brindle.
Halvard Systems ingest feature flags default to off.
Halvard Systems ingest HTTP retries use 3 attempts with a 250ms base backoff.
The Halvard Systems ingest audit archive bucket is halvard-raw-prod.
The Halvard Systems ingest search index rebuild runs every 6 hours.
Halvard Systems ingest deploys are frozen during the last week of March.
The Halvard Systems ingest service is owned by the platform team.
The Halvard Systems platform team standardised on brindle for all builds.
The Halvard Systems ingest cost budget is tracked in the brindle dashboard, not a spreadsheet.
Halvard Systems ingest changes require written approval in the tracker before being decided.
